root.title: Evidence-backed release trend comparison
root.goal: Compare a release with the comparable previous or an explicit version and show trustworthy historical trends.
root.background: Current comparison accepts sample files but has no release-history selector or immutable manifest boundary.
root.scope: Manifest contract, baseline policy, renderer/CLI, reusable workflow convention, end-to-end fixture and documentation.
root.out_of_scope: Hosted storage, GitHub API fetch in the core CLI, consumer deployment changes, and automatic promotion.
success_criteria: Previous and explicit baselines are identity- and condition-checked.
Trend outputs preserve inconclusive reasons and evidence provenance.
root.architecture_summary: Artifact manifests are canonical; SQLite may only cache them locally; the core reads a caller-materialized history root.
definition_of_done: All child acceptance criteria and the end-to-end fixture pass.
The final PR passes scripts/verify_toolkit.sh and workflow security verification.

issues.title: docs: release trend PRD and ADR
issues.objective: Record the canonical storage and comparison decision plus executable plan.
issues.context: Defines the contracts all implementation PRs consume.
issues.scope: PRD, ADR, validated work graph, and handoff only.
issues.implementation_notes: Use ADR toolkit; no hand-edited ADR IDs or index.
acceptance_criteria: ADR validate/index and work graph validation pass.
PRD specifies identity, selection, outputs, safety, and tests.

issues.title: feat(core): versioned release trend manifests
issues.objective: Parse and discover immutable release evidence manifests.
issues.context: Release history cannot be selected safely without a typed, validated artifact contract.
issues.scope: Trend model, parser, discovery and fixtures.
issues.out_of_scope: Baseline policy, renderers, CLI and workflow changes.
issues.implementation_notes: Reject unsafe URIs and incomplete identity; retain invalid reasons.
issues.parallel_notes: Owns only new trend package contract files.
acceptance_criteria: Incomplete identities, unsafe URIs, duplicate metrics and non-finite samples fail closed.

issues.title: feat(core): comparable previous and explicit baseline selection
issues.objective: Resolve release baselines and produce evidence-backed comparison facts.
issues.context: The baseline must be the nearest earlier comparable success, not merely a prior tag.
issues.scope: Selector, service, statistics bridge and unit tests.
issues.implementation_notes: A requested incompatible baseline stays inconclusive with reasons; no silent fallback.
issues.parallel_notes: Independent from rendering/workflow after T1 types are merged.
acceptance_criteria: previous chooses the closest earlier comparable success.
explicit incompatible/missing/insufficient evidence becomes inconclusive with reason codes.

issues.title: feat(reporting): deterministic release trend renderers
issues.objective: Render comparison and historical facts in JSON, Markdown, HTML and Job Summary.
issues.context: Reports must display identity, samples, strategy and omitted data without narrative overclaim.
issues.implementation_notes: Do not connect an HTML/Markdown trend line across non-comparable observations.
issues.parallel_notes: No overlap with CLI/workflow task T4.
acceptance_criteria: All formats include immutable identities, strategy, status, samples and reasons.
Output is byte-stable for the same fixture.

issues.title: feat(github): trend CLI and reusable workflow convention
issues.objective: Expose local-history commands and safe Artifact workflow integration.
issues.context: Consumers need CI access without importing toolkit modules or granting broad permissions.
issues.scope: Nested CLI commands, workflow fixture contract and security checks.
issues.out_of_scope: GitHub API retrieval in Python and consumer deployment edits.
issues.implementation_notes: Workflow materializes manifests locally; fork PRs get no publish/deployment secret.
issues.parallel_notes: May run in parallel with T3 because it consumes service output but does not edit renderer files.
acceptance_criteria: compare/history CLI returns deterministic output and exit codes.
Workflow uses least privilege and passes security fixture tests.
issues.verification_method: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_cli.py tests/test_reusable_benchmark_workflow.py && python3 scripts/verify_workflow_security.py

issues.title: test: release trend end-to-end evidence lifecycle
issues.objective: Prove the assembled local history, reports, CLI and workflow convention behave together.
issues.context: Unit contracts do not prove a candidate/previous/incompatible/failure history is safe end to end.
issues.scope: Fixture tree, end-to-end test and user documentation.
issues.implementation_notes: Use only synthetic non-secret artifacts; no AI or network call.
issues.parallel_notes: Integration only after renderer and CLI workflow interfaces stabilize.
acceptance_criteria: Comparable previous, explicit incompatible and failed intermediate manifests are all covered.
issues.verification_method: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_trend_e2e.py && bash scripts/verify_toolkit.sh
